title: Fix the Iterator That Never Stops
description: The program should define a custom iterator that yields numbers 1 through 3 and then stops. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 1, 2, 3 and then stop.
actualProblem: __next__ never checks self.current against self.limit and never raises StopIteration, so the for loop has no signal to stop and keeps calling __next__ forever, producing an infinite loop.
explanation: The iterator protocol requires __next__ to raise StopIteration once there are no more values to produce. Without that signal, any for loop (or other iteration) consuming the iterator will call __next__ indefinitely.
